title: 第9章 秘术家族祸害第10章 大祖突破准帝林家实力暴涨
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 闻言，众人瞬间纷纷望向声音的来源之处，正是一旁的林轩。
只见林天海立马一脸急切的询问道：
“轩儿，你说你有办法，那究竟是何办法？施行难度大不大？”
随着林天海的发问，周围众人也是纷纷满脸好奇的盯着林轩。
他们也想知道，他林家的这位麒麟儿又能给他们带来怎样的惊喜。
对此，林轩也没有卖关子，直接说道：
“这办法，其实是我在那传承中得到了两份秘术……”
“有一份秘术名叫《禁灵》，修炼了这一份秘术之人，不仅无法自己泄露所知的事情的任何内容，而且就算其他心怀不轨的修士，使用何等秘术都无法获知，足以让我林家的秘密绝不外泄。
至于另一份秘术，则是可以确认族人是否百分百忠于家族，不过这个秘术只有我能使用，就不过多介绍了，但晚辈可以用自己的性命担保，绝对不会出错！”
其实林轩所言半真半假，其中那秘术《禁灵》乃是真实存在，是系统暂时赊账，兑换给林轩的，为此林轩也是再次欠下了一大笔族运点。
至于另一个秘术当然没有了，不过他有族运之眼，随时可以查看族人的信息，这不比秘术好用多了，还不会出错。
不过据系统所说，这《禁灵》秘术无论多强大的修士或是其它秘术，都无法破解或绕过这秘术，从而获得信息……
林轩此时还清晰的记得当时系统那些信誓旦旦的话语……
“叮，本系统出品，必属精品！”
“叮，宿主不要试图质疑本系统，本系统做系统可是认真的！”
“叮，宿主不要拿那些妖艳贱货，和本系统相提并论！”
“叮，如果这秘术的效果有假，不用宿主你说，本系统自己都没脸在系统一族中混了。”
不过虽然系统如此保证，但宰他的时候也是一点不轻啊，直接让他欠了足足200万的“巨额债务”，而他还没有办法不要，不然根本无法得到保障。
不过好在系统给的时间较长，足有1年时间。
这么长的时间他还怕还不清这债务？
随后林轩便将那份名为《禁灵》的秘术拿了出来，并开口道：
“各位长辈请看，这便是那《禁灵》秘术……”
只见一个玉简突然出现在了林轩手中，其中便刻印着那份秘书。
很快众人便一一探查起了玉简的内容，发现其中所记载的内容，确实如林轩所说的一样，甚至更加详细。
而且众人还发现这份秘术修炼的难度非常低，基本人人皆可修炼，且一天内基本可以修炼完成。
看到这里众人也是松了一口气，至少只要是合适并获得资格的族人，他们都可以让他们知晓这些秘密，而不用担心。
能让更多的族人得以快速提升。
“哈哈哈，好好好！”
“不愧是我林家的麒麟儿，就连这些难题都给我们解决了，这样我们便可以放手操作，让我林家快速提升实力，而不用畏手畏脚了，哈哈！”
“没错，没错！”
“那几大势力，等着吧，我林家很快便会将你们通通碾压，桀桀桀！”
待众人逐渐平静下来后，只见大祖林长霄满脸严肃认真的看着林轩，说道：
“轩儿，你对家族做出了如此大的贡献，本应大大重赏于你……只是可惜家族不够强大，无法给予你太大的帮助……”
“不过你放心，在你没有成长起来前，一切有我们这些老家伙顶着，哪怕我等全部牺牲，也定会保你安全，护你成长！”
“轩儿，我代表林家上下所有族人，感谢你对家族做出的重大贡献！”
说完便要对着林轩，行他林家的最好礼仪，而其他众人也是纷纷点头，便对着林轩行礼了起来。
见此，林轩瞬间一惊，但他已经来不及阻止了，只能连忙躲开。
content_en:
Hearing this, everyone immediately looked at the source of the sound, which was Lin Xuan on the side.
Lin Tianhai immediately asked eagerly:
"Xuan'er, you said you have a way, but what is it? Is it difficult to implement it?"
As Lin Tianhai asked questions, everyone around him stared at Lin Xuan with curiosity.
They also wanted to know what surprises this Qilin of the Lin family could bring them.
In this regard, Lin Xuan did not show off and said directly:
"This method is actually because I got two secret techniques from that inheritance..."
"There is a secret technique called "Forbidden Spirit". People who practice this secret technique are not only unable to reveal any content of what they know, but also other monks with evil intentions cannot learn it no matter how much they use the secret technique. This is enough to prevent the secrets of my Lin family from being leaked.
As for the other secret technique, it can confirm whether the clan members are 100% loyal to the family. However, this secret technique can only be used by me, so I won’t introduce it in too much detail. However, the juniors can guarantee it with their own lives, and it will never go wrong! "
In fact, what Lin Xuan said was half true and half false. The secret technique "Forbidden Spirit" was real. It was given to Lin Xuan on temporary credit by the system. For this reason, Lin Xuan once again owed a large amount of clan luck points.
As for the other secret technique, of course he doesn't have it, but he has the Eye of Clan Destiny and can check the information of his clan members at any time. This is not much easier to use than the secret technique, and it will not make mistakes.
However, according to the system, no matter how powerful the "Forbidden Spirit" secret technique is, monks or other secret techniques cannot crack or bypass this secret technique to obtain information...
Lin Xuan still clearly remembers the system's vows at that time...
"Ding, the products produced by this system must be high-quality!"
"Ding, host, don't try to question this system, this system is serious about being a system!"
"Ding, host, don't compare those coquettish bitches with this system!"
"Ding, if the effect of this secret technique is fake, I don't need the host to tell you. This system itself will have no shame in being among the system clan."
…
However, even though the system guaranteed this, it was not at all light when it killed him. It directly caused him to owe a "huge debt" of 2 million yuan, and he had no way to avoid it, otherwise he would not be guaranteed at all.
Fortunately, the system gives a longer time, a full year.
After such a long time, he is still afraid of not being able to pay off this debt?
…
Lin Xuan then took out the secret technique called "Forbidden Spirit" and said:
"Elders, please take a look, this is the secret technique of "Forbidden Spirit"..."
A jade slip suddenly appeared in Lin Xuan's hand, with the secretary's job engraved on it.
Soon everyone began to explore the contents of the jade slips one by one and found that the contents recorded in them were indeed as Lin Xuan said, even more detailed.
Moreover, everyone also found that the difficulty of practicing this secret technique is very low, basically everyone can practice it, and it can basically be completed in one day.
Everyone was relieved to see this. At least as long as they were suitable and qualified tribesmen, they could let them know these secrets without worrying.
It allows more tribesmen to advance quickly.
"Hahaha, good, good!"
"As expected of the Qilin'er of my Lin family, even these problems have been solved for us, so that we can freely operate and let my Lin family quickly improve our strength without being timid, haha!"
"That's right, that's right!"
"Those major forces, just wait, my Lin family will crush you all soon, Jie Jie Jie!"
…
After everyone gradually calmed down, the great ancestor Lin Changxiao looked at Lin Xuan seriously and said:
"Xuan'er, you have made such a great contribution to the family, and you should be greatly rewarded... It's just a pity that the family is not strong enough to give you much help..."
"But don't worry, until you grow up, we old guys are responsible for everything. Even if we all sacrifice, we will definitely keep you safe and protect you as you grow up!"
"Xuan'er, on behalf of all the Lin family members, I would like to thank you for your great contribution to the family!"
After saying that, he had to face Lin Xuan and follow the best etiquette of the Lin family. Everyone else nodded and saluted Lin Xuan.
Seeing this, Lin Xuan was shocked for a moment, but he had no time to stop him and could only dodge quickly.
